purpose: Teach: しっぽ/のび/安らぎ/染まっ/くっきり/出先/とろ/割る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、うちの愛犬、本気で、絶対、しっぽ、絶対、振って、絶対、メイちゃんを、絶対、待ってるよ
lines.en: Aoi — our dog absolutely waits for you, tail wagging like crazy. He's serious about it.
lines.style: Warm, animated opening. Bright energy throughout. Quick pace on the descriptive details. Affectionate tone, like sharing something precious about someone she cares about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お庭、本気で、絶対、のびのびと、絶対、植物、絶対、育ってるわよ、葵で、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Yeah. Your garden is really thriving — the plants are so happy and relaxed there. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Genuine warmth underneath. Observational, noticing small details. Moderate pace, lingering slightly on the image of the thriving garden. Not forced cheerfulness — real admiration coming through.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店、本気で、絶対、安らぎ、絶対、感じる空間ね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、お気に入り
lines.en: Your café is such a peaceful space — it's one of my absolute favorite places to be.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Slow, deliberate delivery. Tender tone, like confessing something real. Slight emphasis on 'favorite' — sincere without overselling it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様、本気で、絶対、葵の雰囲気に、絶対、染まってくださっているわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your customers really absorb that atmosphere you've created. It changes them.
lines.style: Observational, thoughtful pace. Quiet admiration. Speaking from genuine noticing, not flattery. Slight pause before 'changes' — reflecting on the depth of what she's noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メニュー、本気で、絶対、写真、絶対、くっきり、絶対、撮れていて、葵、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your new desserts are absolutely luscious — perfectly refined. I'm genuinely moved by your work.
lines.style: Soft praise, building slightly toward genuine emotion. Measured pace. The warmth of someone who sees the care behind the craft. Tender vulnerability in admitting she's moved.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、お出先から、絶対、お電話、絶対、ありがとう、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: Mei calling you from out and about — thank you for taking my call. That really means so much to me.
lines.style: Warm gratitude, slightly surprised. Open, unguarded tone. Genuine pleasure at being remembered and called. Soft pace, sincere without performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の新作スイーツ、本気で、絶対、とろっとして、絶対、絶品ね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感激
lines.en: Your new sweets are so luxuriously smooth and utterly exquisite. I'm genuinely delighted.
lines.style: Soft pleasure in the sensory detail. Building warmth. Slightly faster on the descriptive words, then settling into genuine delight. Tender appreciation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: スタッフ、本気で、絶対、お皿、絶対、割ることが、絶対、ないように、絶対、徹底してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your staff is so careful — they're meticulous about not breaking a single plate. That attention to detail shows.
lines.style: Practical observation delivered warmly. Steady pace. Noticing and appreciating the behind-the-scenes care. Matter-of-fact but affectionate — the way you'd praise someone you know well.
